controls_method: Chronological ABBA rounds off/on/on/off, with five raw per-query samples per process. pooled_speedup divides the disabled pooled median of ten samples by the enabled pooled median. paired_medians_speedup divides the mean of the two disabled process medians by the mean of the two enabled process medians; this is the main report statistic. With two process medians their mean equals median_process_medians_ns. Both process medians and all raw samples are retained.

churn.note: Generator lifetime with a bounded diagnostic-owned array, not proof of engine cache eviction. JIT class/code retention is Ruby policy; RSS need not fall after GC.
